pages.text: Dragon Nip is a status effect that makes affected Dragons passive for the effects duration & allows for taming wild Dragons.
pages.title: Basic Information

pages.text: When a Dragon initially acquires the Dragon Nip Effect any current hostility is lost, and the dragon remains passive for the duration of the effect. $(br2)Additionally, while this effect is active on a wild dragon, it allows players to tame them without meeting the Dragons Taming Requirements (the correct food item is still required in its regular quantity).
pages.title: Effect Information
